meta.name: 1password
meta.description: Set up and use 1Password CLI (op). Use when installing the CLI, enabling desktop app integration, signing in (single or multi-account), or reading/injecting/running secrets via op.

copy.tagline: 通过命令行管理密码与密钥注入
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要安全地管理密码或注入密钥到开发环境
copy.tagline_en: Manage passwords and inject secrets via CLI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to securely manage passwords or inject secrets into your development environment

howto.what: 安装并配置 1Password CLI，在 tmux 会话中执行登录、读取密钥、注入密钥等操作，确保不将密钥泄露到日志或对话中。
howto.when: 当需要安装 1Password CLI、启用桌面应用集成、登录（单账户或多账户）、或通过 op 命令读取/注入/运行密钥时触发。

say.text: 帮我安装 1Password CLI 并登录。
say.note: 会执行安装和登录流程。

say.text: 用 op 读取 vault 中的某个密码。
say.note: 会在 tmux 中执行 op 命令。

say.text: 帮我用 op inject 将密钥注入到配置文件中。

howto.what_en: Install and configure 1Password CLI, perform sign-in, read/inject/run secrets via op commands inside a dedicated tmux session, and never leak secrets to logs or chat.
howto.when_en: Triggered when installing 1Password CLI, enabling desktop app integration, signing in (single or multi-account), or reading/injecting/running secrets via op.

say_en.text: Read a password from a vault using op.
Inject secrets into a config file using op inject.
